title: Lookup account balance
description: Sign in with a member ID, open the dashboard, and read the Checking or Savings balance from a stable test id.

page_not_found.description: Target route returned 404 / page not found.

member_id.description: Opaque member login id: letters followed by exactly three digits. Do not store real personal names in artifacts; supply this at invoke time.

bank_url.description: Atlas Bank login URL for this environment.

balance.description: Available balance string extracted from the account card.

target.robustness: Prefer data-testid attributes; they are stable across copy changes and less brittle than visible text.

success_conditions.description: Signed-in member chrome is visible on the page.
Savings account balance card/text is present.
Checking account balance card/text is present.
A transfer id or matching ledger rows are available.

query_signatures: what is my checking account balance
